derived_from: Exact C27 generation instructions and complete Covenant; new revision contract permits replacing unpublished choices and developing reciprocal participation.
planned_scope: Three single-response editing diagnostics from original C27 drafts: B03 group discussion of a premise, B07 response to an exact player manuscript, A13 full delegated game. Zero fresh player turns; no selection claim.
hypothesis: C27 sometimes removes the contribution along with the rhetoric and sometimes begins with an underdeveloped draft. Revision may rebuild the current interaction while preserving published canon, full backgrounds and player authorship.
limitations: Changes editorial authority and participation guidance together. New isolated editors receive complete published prior fiction and original draft, not the source author conversation containing all prior drafts. This is a bounded editing screen, not a controlled one-variable effect or a live two-request trial. First outputs retained without rerolls.
